*
FROM ( SELECT GADW.SKYSAKICD , SKYM.SKYSAKINMN1 , SKYM.SKYSAKINMN2 , SKYM.YUBINNO , SKYM.ADRSN1 , SKYM.ADRSN2 , SKYM.ADRSN3 , STKM1.MOJISETTEIATAI AS RENRAKUSAKINOKBNN1 , SKYM.RENRAKUSAKINON1 , STKM2.MOJISETTEIATAI AS RENRAKUSAKINOKBNN2 , SKYM.RENRAKUSAKINON2 , STKM3.MOJISETTEIATAI AS RENRAKUSAKINOKBNN3 , SKYM.RENRAKUSAKINON3 , STKM4.MOJISETTEIATAI AS RENRAKUSAKINOKBNN4 , SKYM.RENRAKUSAKINON4 , SKYM.CRDTCRDYUKOKBN , GADW.GMOKAIINNO , GADW.GMORENKEICSVIMAGEKEKKA , CASE WHEN INSTR(GADW.GMORENKEICSVIMAGEKEKKA, ',', 1, 5) = 0 THEN '9999' ELSE SUBSTR( GADW.GMORENKEICSVIMAGEKEKKA , INSTR(GADW.GMORENKEICSVIMAGEKEKKA, ',', 1, 4) + 1 , INSTR(GADW.GMORENKEICSVIMAGEKEKKA, ',', 1, 5) - INSTR(GADW.GMORENKEICSVIMAGEKEKKA, ',', 1, 4) - 1 ) END AS OLD_YUKOKGN , CASE WHEN INSTR(GADW.GMORENKEICSVIMAGEKEKKA, ',', 1, 4) = 0 THEN '"9999"' ELSE SUBSTR( GADW.GMORENKEICSVIMAGEKEKKA , INSTR(GADW.GMORENKEICSVIMAGEKEKKA, ',', 1, 3) + 1 , INSTR(GADW.GMORENKEICSVIMAGEKEKKA, ',', 1, 4) - INSTR(GADW.GMORENKEICSVIMAGEKEKKA, ',', 1, 3) - 1 ) END AS NEW_YUKOKGN , GADW.GMOYUKOKGNKSHNSAIN , NVL(TKSC.TOKUISAKI_CNT, 0) AS TOKUISAKI_CNT , NVL(TKSC.TAIKAIZUMI_CNT, 0) AS TAIKAIZUMI_CNT FROM S09W005T GADW INNER JOIN S02M017T SKYM ON( SKYM.APKIHONCD = GADW.APKIHONCD AND SKYM.SHOPCD = GADW.SHOPCD AND SKYM.SKYSAKICD = GADW.SKYSAKICD ) LEFT JOIN S02M006T STKM1 ON( STKM1.APKIHONCD = '000' AND STKM1.SHOPCD = '000' AND STKM1.SETTEINO = '011' AND STKM1.RCRDKBN = 'M' AND STKM1.SETTEICD = SKYM.RENRAKUSAKINOKBNN1 AND STKM1.YUKOKBN = '1' ) LEFT JOIN S02M006T STKM2 ON( STKM2.APKIHONCD = '000' AND STKM2.SHOPCD = '000' AND STKM2.SETTEINO = '011' AND STKM2.RCRDKBN = 'M' AND STKM2.SETTEICD = SKYM.RENRAKUSAKINOKBNN2 AND STKM2.YUKOKBN = '1' ) LEFT JOIN S02M006T STKM3 ON( STKM3.APKIHONCD = '000' AND STKM3.SHOPCD = '000' AND STKM3.SETTEINO = '011' AND STKM3.RCRDKBN = 'M' AND STKM3.SETTEICD = SKYM.RENRAKUSAKINOKBNN3 AND STKM3.YUKOKBN = '1' ) LEFT JOIN S02M006T STKM4 ON( STKM4.APKIHONCD = '000' AND STKM4.SHOPCD = '000' AND STKM4.SETTEINO = '011' AND STKM4.RCRDKBN = 'M' AND STKM4.SETTEICD = SKYM.RENRAKUSAKINOKBNN4 AND STKM4.YUKOKBN = '1' ) LEFT JOIN( SELECT TKSM.APKIHONCD , TKSM.SHOPCD , TKSM.SKYSAKICD , COUNT(*) AS TOKUISAKI_CNT , SUM( CASE TKSM.JOTAISTS WHEN '02' THEN '1' WHEN '06' THEN '1' WHEN '10' THEN '1' ELSE '0' END ) AS TAIKAIZUMI_CNT FROM S02M013T TKSM WHERE TKSM.APKIHONCD = #{entity.apkihoncd} AND TKSM.SHOPCD = #{entity.shopcd} AND TKSM.YUKOKBN = '1' GROUP BY TKSM.APKIHONCD , TKSM.SHOPCD , TKSM.SKYSAKICD ) TKSC ON( TKSC.APKIHONCD = GADW.APKIHONCD AND TKSC.SHOPCD = GADW.SHOPCD AND TKSC.SKYSAKICD = GADW.SKYSAKICD ) WHERE GADW.APKIHONCD = #{entity.apkihoncd} AND GADW.SHOPCD = #{entity.shopcd} AND GADW.SHIMEDYDM = #{entity.dydm1} AND GADW.GMORENKEICSVIMAGEKEKKA IS NOT NULL )
WHERE ( CASE WHEN INSTR(NEW_YUKOKGN, '"', 1, 1) = 0 THEN OLD_YUKOKGN ELSE SUBSTR(NEW_YUKOKGN, 2, 4) END ) <= #{entity.dydm1Yymm} AND GMOYUKOKGNKSHNSAIN = '0'
ORDER BY SKYSAKICD

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT GADW.KEKKATORIKOMIDD , GADW.GMOYUKOSEIHANTEIKEKKA , GADW.GMOKAIINNOKSHNSAIN , GADW.GMOYUKOKGNKSHNSAIN , GADW.GMOKAIINNO , GADW.SKYSAKICD , GADW.SKYSAKIMASUTAKSHNKEKKA , SKSM.SKYSAKINMN1 FROM S09W005T GADW LEFT JOIN S02M017T SKSM ON ( GADW.APKIHONCD = SKSM.APKIHONCD AND GADW.SHOPCD = SKSM.SHOPCD AND GADW.SKYSAKICD = SKSM.SKYSAKICD ) WHERE GADW.APKIHONCD = #{record.apkihoncd,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND GADW.SHOPCD = #{record.shopcd,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND GADW.SHIMEDYDM >= #{record.dydm1,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND GADW.SHIMEDYDM <= #{record.dydm2,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
AND GADW.KSIKKNCD = #{record.ksikknnm,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
AND ( 0 = 1
OR GADW.GMOYUKOSEIHANTEIKEKKA = '1'
OR GADW.GMOYUKOSEIHANTEIKEKKA = '2'
OR GADW.GMOYUKOSEIHANTEIKEKKA = '3'
OR GADW.GMOYUKOSEIHANTEIKEKKA = '8'
OR GADW.GMOKAIINNOKSHNSAIN = '1'
OR GADW.GMOYUKOKGNKSHNSAIN = '1'
OR ( GADW.GMOYUKOSEIHANTEIKEKKA IN ('0', '9') AND GADW.GMOKAIINNOKSHNSAIN = '0' AND GADW.GMOYUKOKGNKSHNSAIN = '0' )
)
AND GADW.SKYSAKIMASUTAKSHNKEKKA = '2'
AND ( GADW.GMOKAIINNO = #{record.kaiinno,jdbcType=VARCHAR} OR GADW.GMOSHINKAIINNO = #{record.kaiinno,jdbcType=VARCHAR} )
AND GADW.SKYSAKICD = #{record.skysakicd,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
ORDER BY GADW.SKYSAKICD ) WHERE ROWNUM <= #{rownum} + 1
SELECT MAX(SHIMEDYDM) AS MAXSHIMEDYDM FROM S09W005T WHERE APKIHONCD = #{apkihoncd} AND SHOPCD = #{shopcd}
SELECT COUNT(*) AS RECORD_COUNT , MAX(IRAIDD) AS IRAIDD FROM S09W005T WHERE SHIMEDYDM = #{prcsdydm, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND IRAIDD IS NOT NULL
SELECT COUNT(*) AS RECORD_COUNT FROM S09W005T WHERE SHIMEDYDM = #{prcsdydm, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND GMOSPID = #{gmospid, jdbcType=NUMERIC}
